summary: Insurance claim for prawn cultivation loss; White Spot Disease outbreak; repudiation challenged; admissible loss computation via three methods (input cost, unit cost, fortnightly valuation); NCDRC relied on disputed survey; average body weight determination critical; validity: insurance policy conditions upheld; mortality threshold 80% per covered pond; proper record maintenance disputed; final valuation assessment based on Death Certificate vs surveyor reports.
final_judgment: Remand for correct loss quantification via prescribed methods; NCDRC award modified.
